name: Mimic
description: Copies the last ability an enemy within %cast_range% tiles was seen casting, wielding it as this unit's own for %duration% turns.
details: This unit remembers what each enemy cast for %steal_window% turns after seeing it.
Only %max_abilities% copied ability can be held at a time - taking a new one hands the old back.
A discarded copy keeps cooling down in the background and returns with whatever cooldown it had left.
